clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one processor cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: the selected on-chip oscillator is divided by four to produce the internal processor clocks
clock_model.limitation: oscillator analog behavior, pad delay, setup/hold, and EPROM programming pulse width are outside the normalized boundary
